claims.claim: Bought as brand new working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a standing electric fan that appears intact with no obvious broken grille wires, but no test results (noise, wobble, speed control, oscillation) are shown.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model, rating plate, or usage indicators are reported; condition details like bearing wear or wobble are not shown.
Witness report does not include internal inspection or evidence of whether the motor housing was opened.
No documents are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Fan may not actually work as claimed (e.g., weak motor, intermittent power, or failing capacitor) even if it looks intact
risks.proof: Short video of the fan running from start-up showing stable airflow, no burning smell, and consistent speed changes (low→high) while the camera stays on the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used fan with unknown working condition (worst case: not guaranteed to run properly).

risks.risk: Speed control may be faulty (panel/knob may move but not change speed)
risks.proof: Clip showing the speed knob/controls being adjusted with the blade RPM visibly changing (or a tachometer app reading changing) and no stalling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if speed control may not function (worst case: only one speed).

risks.risk: Oscillation/tilt function may not work (if present)
risks.proof: Video of the fan oscillating/tilting through its full range and returning smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if oscillation/tilt does not work.

risks.risk: Bearing wear or imbalance could cause wobble/noise at higher speeds
risks.proof: Video at high speed showing whether the head wobbles and whether there is abnormal grinding/squealing noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if bearing/balance condition is uncertain (worst case: noisy/wobbly).

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (loose wiring, damaged cord, faulty plug) not visible from exterior angles
risks.proof: Photo of the plug and power cord close-up plus a clip showing the cord flexed slightly while running (no sparking/heat).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if electrical condition is not guaranteed (worst case: needs inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Brand/model and power rating unknown; value depends heavily on watts and quality
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/label (brand, model, voltage, watts) on the motor housing or base.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for generic standing fans due to unknown specifications.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/label showing brand, model, voltage, and watts.
Video showing the fan turning on and running smoothly, including low-to-high speed changes.
Video confirming oscillation/tilt (if the fan has it) and that it completes full movement.
Close-up photos of the plug and entire power cord (no cuts/repairs).
Video showing no wobble and no abnormal noise at high speed.
Photos/scans of the receipt and warranty card (with dates).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a standing electric fan and reports it appears intact, so a worst-case price can be set without relying on the seller’s unverified claims. However, key functional details (speed control, oscillation, bearing condition, electrical safety) are not shown, so it should be priced conservatively until the requested proof is provided.
